annotations.title: Traffic-aware travel time and distance between two places

description: Travel time and distance between two places with live traffic, from the Google Routes API at call time: duration with traffic, duration without, the delay between them, distance, Google's localized texts, route description, warnings and advisory. Places are addresses, place names or "lat,lng". Input: origin, destination; optional travel_mode (DRIVE, TWO_WHEELER, WALK, BICYCLE, TRANSIT), departure_time (RFC 3339, future; omit to leave now), traffic (aware, optimal, none). $0.10 per call. Returns: origin, destination, travel_mode, traffic, departure_time, distance_meters, duration_seconds, static_duration_seconds, delay_seconds, duration_text, static_duration_text, distance_text, description, warnings[], advisory, source, as_of, checked_at.

departure_time.description: RFC 3339 departure time in the future (2026-09-27T16:30:00Z); omit to leave now.

destination.description: Where the trip ends: an address, a place name, or "lat,lng".

origin.description: Where the trip starts: an address, a place name, or "lat,lng".

traffic.description: aware (default): live traffic; optimal: live traffic with the best route quality, slower; none: no traffic.

travel_mode.description: Default DRIVE. Traffic applies to DRIVE and TWO_WHEELER only.

name: hubvibe_traffic_route

outputSchema.description: The 200 body of every paid /work call. `result` is the worker's own output (its schema is per route); everything else is the same on every /work route. A receipt for the job is at `receipt_url`.

billing_warning.description: Present only when the charge was recorded with a caveat.

price_usd.description: What this call cost, in USD.

provenance.description: How the result was produced: which providers ran and how long each took.

attempts.description: Provider attempts made, including retries and failovers.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the whole job.

steps.description: Every step the job ran, in order.

reason.description: Failure reason, on a failed step.

receipt_url.description: Where to fetch the machine-readable receipt (free, no payment).

advisory.description: Google's travelAdvisory object for the route (tolls, speed reading intervals, fuel) exactly as returned, {} when it has nothing to say; null when absent.

as_of.description: The departure time the answer was computed for: `departure_time`, else `checked_at`.

checked_at.description: When this node read the source (UTC). Nothing here is cached.

delay_seconds.description: duration_seconds minus static_duration_seconds (negative when traffic is lighter than typical); null when either is unknown.

departure_time.description: Departure time sent to Google (RFC 3339, UTC); null when the trip starts now.

description.description: Route description as Google names it (main roads); null when not given.

duration_seconds.description: Travel time in seconds, with traffic when `traffic` is aware or optimal.

source.description: Data source: Google Routes API computeRoutes.

static_duration_seconds.description: Travel time in seconds without traffic; null when Google does not state it.

static_duration_text.description: Google's localized travel time without traffic.

traffic.description: Traffic handling used: aware (live traffic), optimal (live traffic, best route quality), none (no traffic; always none for WALK, BICYCLE and TRANSIT).

warnings.description: Google's warnings for the route, in the order given; empty when none.

items.description: A warning Google attaches to the route.

status.description: Present only on a delivered result.

worker.description: Catalog name of the worker that ran.

outputSchema.title: traffic.route response

title: Traffic-aware travel time and distance between two places
